{{Quote|Master Luke and his friends have the Empire's ''western flank'' under ''siege'' at this moment.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="RNS" />}}
The '''siege of the Galactic Empire's western flank''' was an event of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that took place while [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were on a [[Mission to Ronyards|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ronyards/Legends|Ronyards]].
